extension.description: Original skin: Andy Morton[CR]Original design: Simon Brunton[CR]Skinner: Julian Michel
extension.news: [B]New[/B][CR]- add support for Kodi v22 (Piers)[CR]- add Dolby Vision profile to the HDR media flag[CR]- add extra title info, parental rating and backend name to PVR items[CR]- add live bitrates, queue levels and subtitle decoder to the process info dialog[CR]- add ungroup button to the video versions manager[CR]- add controller image to the peripheral settings dialog[CR]- add support for Skin Shortcuts v3[CR]- add select dialog for skin settings that are not switches[CR]- add option to show titles on artwork in wall views and widgets[CR]- add option to show two widgets on screen at once[CR]- add PVR providers window for the broadcasters behind channels and recordings[CR]- give audio and subtitle streams a row each in the fullscreen info[CR]- add spinner to the weather widget while it updates[CR]- add last update time to the weather window[CR][CR][B]Improved[/B][CR]- step through subtitles in both directions in the video OSD[CR]- open subtitle settings from the subtitle name in the video OSD[CR]- name audio and subtitle streams by their stream name[CR]- detect Dolby Atmos and DTS:X from the stream, not the file name[CR]- separate genres, directors and writers with commas[CR]- hide duration based information during live playback[CR]- read codec and channel labels from shared lookup maps[CR]- size the process info dialog to the rows it shows[CR]- pre-configure layout, artwork and sort of every widget[CR]- allow any item limit on main menu widgets[CR]- localise artwork type names in the widget artwork pickers[CR]- offer every artwork type in the widget artwork pickers[CR]- remove clear logo and fake landscape widget artwork types[CR]- offer date sorting on live TV and radio widgets[CR]- show the sort of pre-configured widgets in the management dialog[CR]- remove the always show settings link setting, as settings cannot be removed[CR]- sort the unwatched music videos widget by title, not at random[CR]- drop the fifty item cap on most played album and song playlists[CR]- disable delete and hide on menu items that cannot be removed[CR]- disable restore while nothing has been deleted[CR]- give every group in the shortcut and widget pickers its own icon[CR]- name the reset button in skin settings for everything it clears[CR]- offer artwork titles and watched indicator settings from a view's sub menu[CR]- return to the sub menu when leaving the view picker with back[CR]- stop drawing a fanart layer where there is no fanart[CR]- clear the screen on the windows that fill it[CR]- draw the focus line with the control instead of in its texture[CR]- cut texture memory by three fifths[CR]- redraw every icon from a traced outline at the size it is drawn[CR]- keep one set of watched status overlays rather than two[CR]- reset scrolled text boxes when a dialog or menu closes over them[CR]- drive every scroll reset from one token instead of twenty six properties[CR]- scroll every label at a speed set by its own font size[CR][CR][B]Fixed[/B][CR]- fix audio channel labels naming layouts a channel count cannot identify[CR]- fix the Dolby Vision profile 7 flag reading as one word[CR]- fix the audio flag describing more than one track[CR]- fix the twelfth line of system information not showing[CR]- fix the last row of the game controller lists being cut off[CR]- fix the recently added artists widget pointing at a missing playlist[CR]- fix the music add-on widget resolving to nothing[CR]- fix the live TV and radio widgets opening the videos window[CR]- fix the rip disc row and artist widgets pointing at missing artwork[CR]- fix video widgets falling back to music artwork[CR]- fix movie set, music node and custom widgets carrying the wrong type[CR]- fix the weather widget being recognised by a property v3 never sets[CR]- fix the seeded live TV and radio widgets differing from the picker's[CR]- fix the three widget artwork slots drawing over one another[CR]- fix picked widgets drawing icons whatever their content[CR]- fix the games widget missing the sort orders it lists add-ons for[CR]- fix the random movie, TV show and album widgets having two names[CR]- fix the management dialog offering no sort for pre-configured widgets[CR]- fix the random movie and music video widgets sorting the wrong way[CR]- fix the widget property pickers showing a crossed circle on every option[CR]- fix the Skin Shortcuts entry points showing while the add-on is disabled[CR]- fix the login screen scrollbar covering the profile list[CR]- fix the profile settings scrollbar rendering without track or bar[CR]- fix the debug grid ignoring its offset on the masked aspect ratios[CR]- fix the blank channel label in the fullscreen OSD and guide dialog[CR]- fix the watched status bar and its overlay swapping size in the video wall[CR]- fix the focused status badge in the music wall low view at 16:9[CR]- fix three layouts at 4:3 sizing their contents for a wider screen[CR]- fix the music window fading twice on open[CR]- fix the missing widget heading on menu entries with several widgets[CR]- fix episodes losing the skin's numbering in list view and on widgets[CR]- fix the channel lists showing the programme thumbnail, not the logo[CR]- fix navigation in the video and music OSD stopping at hidden buttons[CR]- fix left and right leaving the subtitle row in the video OSD[CR]- fix being unable to leave the TV guide with the scrollbar hidden[CR]- render every icon at the largest size it is drawn at[CR]- fix fifteen icons being enlarged in the select dialog preview[CR]- fix the movie artwork placeholder never being drawn[CR]- fix the OSMC logo on the home and login screens being resampled[CR]- fix the sub menu arrows being 32 pixels in a 30 pixel box[CR]- fix the shortcut management arrows rendering at a ninth of full strength[CR]- fix the list indicator's up arrow rendering at half the strength of its down arrow[CR]- render the video, duration, timer and reminder flags at their drawn size[CR]- redraw the encrypted channel padlock at the size it is drawn[CR]- fix the encrypted channel padlock drawing seams where its shapes overlap, and dimming itself twice[CR]- fix the list indicator arrows running into the edge of their texture[CR]- draw the four media flags as one family, at one size and one stroke weight[CR]- fix the watched flag in the PVR recordings list being oversized[CR]- fix the subtitle position marker in the calibration screen being stretched[CR]- redraw the busy spinner with antialiased edges[CR]- add a small busy spinner for the places that need one[CR]- fix the busy spinner sitting below and right of centre[CR]- make the error icon monochrome like the rest of the set[CR]- fix drop shadows on the home menu and PVR timer icons[CR]- fix the video watched status setting leaving movie sets untouched
